BlankPageStatus.description:
Blank page detection status (Spec §7.B).

All statuses remain CROP_READY (non-blocking warning).
BlankPageStatus.title: BlankPageStatus

ClassificationStatus.description:
Layout classification status from the classifier engine (Spec §2, §11).

These represent the outcome of TAHAP 1: In-Memory Layout Classifier Engine.
ClassificationStatus.title: ClassificationStatus

CropReadinessStatus.description:
Crop execution readiness status from safety guardrails (Spec §2, §11).

These represent the outcome of TAHAP 2: Crop Strategy Router &
Safety Guardrails Validator.
CropReadinessStatus.title: CropReadinessStatus

CropRegion.description:
A single rectangular crop region in PDF coordinate space.

Defines the bounding box [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in points for
one output page, plus target pixel dimensions at the profile DPI.

Coordinate system follows PyMuPDF convention (origin at top-left).

region_id.description: Output filename stem for this region (e.g. 'PAGE-01', 'PAGE-02', 'COVER', 'BACKCOVER')
region_id.title: Region Id

quadrant.description: Quadrant index for 4-Up layout (1=TL, 2=TR, 3=BL, 4=BR). None for non-4-Up.
quadrant.title: Quadrant

x_min_pt.description: Left edge of crop region in points
x_min_pt.title: X Min Pt

y_min_pt.description: Top edge of crop region in points
y_min_pt.title: Y Min Pt

x_max_pt.description: Right edge of crop region in points
x_max_pt.title: X Max Pt

y_max_pt.description: Bottom edge of crop region in points
y_max_pt.title: Y Max Pt

target_width_px.description: Expected output width in pixels at render DPI
target_width_px.title: Target Width Px

target_height_px.description: Expected output height in pixels at render DPI
target_height_px.title: Target Height Px

blank_page_status.description: Blank page detection result (Spec §7.B). Non-blocking warning.

CropRegion.title: CropRegion

CropStrategyType.description: Crop strategy types mapped 1:1 to layout types (Spec §8.B).
CropStrategyType.title: CropStrategyType

LayoutType.description: Layout types identified by the classifier (Spec §4, §11).
LayoutType.title: LayoutType

ManualReviewFlag.description:
Flags indicating reason for manual review hold (Spec §2, §6, §8, §11).

Multiple flags may be present on a single page.
ManualReviewFlag.title: ManualReviewFlag

description:
Crop plan for a single PDF page/sheet.

Combines classification results from TAHAP 1 (Layout Classifier)
with crop readiness from TAHAP 2 (Safety Guardrails), and lists
the CropRegion(s) to extract from this page.

pdf_page_index.description: Zero-based page index in the PDF document
pdf_page_index.title: Pdf Page Index

width_pt.description: Page width from page.rect in points
width_pt.title: Width Pt

height_pt.description: Page height from page.rect in points
height_pt.title: Height Pt

rotation.description: PDF page rotation value (0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees)
rotation.title: Rotation

crop_regions.description: List of crop regions to extract from this page
crop_regions.title: Crop Regions

expected_page_yield.description: Number of book pages this sheet produces (Cover=2, 4-Up=4, Single=1, Unknown=0)
expected_page_yield.title: Expected Page Yield

title: PageCropPlan
